deploy-bot: preflight check triggered for release 2026-03-21T22:00Z (canary -> 10%).

deploy-bot: SLO preflight results:
• embed-service /route=embeddings: 5xx rate 0.82% (threshold 0.5%) 
• p95 latency stable at 180ms ✅

deploy-bot: Action suggested: pause rollout and run quick rollback/pin check.

nora: saw the spike, looks correlated with new quantized build. can we pause? :eyes: 
aj: yes please pause. i'm seeing identical spike on eu-west k8s logs. suspect CUDA kernel mismatch on q4 quant.

sam: pausing now. @deploy-bot pause rollout for release 2026-03-21T22:00Z
deploy-bot: rollout paused by sam (reason: preflight 5xx > threshold).

tess: if we pause, do we pin to previous stable? Release notes already published — link: https://redwoodinternal/release/2026-03-21/1234 (note: docs include quant changes)

aj: recommend pin to v1.4.2 (last-green). command: `rbk pin-version --service=embed-service --version=v1.4.2 --reason="preflight 5xx spike"`

matt: +1. also can we run a targeted replay against the canary traffic subset to confirm reproducibility? i can spin a job.

sam: matt, go ahead. run replay against canary-traffic for 20 minutes. tag traces with `canary-replay-4832`

matt: started replay job: job-id 20260321-rc-replay-4832. will post if we see same error pattern.

aj: for tracking — created incident draft: INC-4832-canary-embed-5xx, assigned to eng-platform and eng-sre.

nora: oncall note: i'll keep monitoring dashboards and will escalate if p50/p95 degrade. Current 5xx spike concentrated on `/v1/embeddings` route with backend error code 500x3 pattern.

tess: prod/pm heads are looped in. we should hold the changewindow until root cause. can we also add a roll-forward guard in release config to prevent auto-resume?

sam: added guard in release config: `auto_resume: false` and `max_traffic_step: 10%` unchanged.

matt: replay shows same stacktrace for failing requests — NPE inside quant lib `quant_kv.cu:142`. forwarding logs to model-ops: https://redwoodinternal/logs/2026/4832

aj: model-ops pinged. suggest we keep pin in place, attach rollback note to release: "Pin to v1.4.2 due to quant kernel 5xx spike in canary."

sam: agreed. I'll update the release notes and cut a quick rollback changelog.

deploy-bot: rollout status: PAUSED. Current traffic: canary 10% -> paused. Pin command queued.

nora: thanks — i'll watch alerts and reopen thread if metrics stabilise. :thumbsup:

sam: follow-up checklist for owners: [matt] replay analysis, [aj] pin + incident triage, [model-ops] investigate kernel mismatch. target: update in 30m.

matt: will post quick findings: initial hypothesis is quantization-induced memory alignment on newer CUDA driver.

deploy-bot: reminder: please annotate the incident with the release id and changewindow tag `changewindow-2026-03-21`.

aj: pinned command executed: `rbk pin-version --service=embed-service --version=v1.4.2` — confirmed. routing switched back for canary traffic.

sam: closing note: putting rollforward on hold until model-ops confirms fix. release manager will sign off for any subsequent attempt.

nora: threads for follow-ups: eng-platform for kernel fix, eng-releases for re-run preflight, eng-oncall for monitoring.

(most messages are short updates; reactions: :white_check_mark: from sam, :eyes: from tess)
